label: Coalescence and record correction distinguish state certainty from historical authenticity
paraphrase: Explicit Boolean structural controls: an erasing law makes every positive-time state false while complete trajectories still vary; a reversible toggling law preserves state variation while a Unit readout erases it; a two-input accurate restriction gives sound records without fixing one initial state; unrestricted true- and false-past inputs share a positive record, defeating soundness and uniformity despite essential origin markers and existing designated bearers on one unchanged populated roster; an inhabited uniformly false positive fiber is uniform but has no authentic witness and is unsound; a deterministic many-to-one copy rule corrects records by reading a retained past coordinate, whereas a rule stamping a positive record irrespective of that coordinate is unsound. These witnesses are mathematical assignments, not metaphysically possible fabricated histories or estimates of actual error.
